objective: Add an isolated shared-Traefik private-pilot edge and host-only credential lifecycle.
outcome: Traefik retains public ports, AXIGNAL binds only to loopback, credentials stay on the host, and deployment cannot self-approve acceptance.

skills.activation_reason: Preserve AXIGNAL-GOAL-001 and the private-pilot boundary.
Resolve governance, security, delivery and operations contracts.
Register the discovered material infrastructure task before deployment.
Keep physical deployment and independent acceptance fail-closed.
Review public ports, proxy trust and secret custody.
Minimise operator identity and credential exposure.
Define non-sensitive deployment and credential metadata.
Preserve reproducible Compose and CI boundaries.
Add negative port, secret and acceptance-state tests.
Design deploy, rotate, verify and rollback operations.
Maintain executable deployment and credential runbooks.

external: review and merge required before VPS mutation

allowed_scope: affected pilot workflows and verification scripts
Contracts 19, ADR-011, roadmap, task and runbook documentation
prohibited_scope: Modification or restart of incumbent Traefik services
Storage of credential values in Git, CI, logs, captures or messages

acceptance_evidence.description: No public AXIGNAL port and no deployment self-acceptance
Executable shared-edge and credential lifecycle runbook

rollback.strategy: Revert the PR before deployment; after deployment stop only AXIGNAL and remove only its dynamic route.
rollback.kill_switch: Remove /etc/traefik/dynamic/axignal-pilot.yml and stop the axignal-pilot Compose project.

goal_lock_checks.evidence: A reliable private pilot enables governed investigation evidence to be exercised.
No claim, evidence or provenance semantics change.
All product lenses and shared context remain unchanged.
No intent or economic-evidence boundary changes.
Infrastructure remains locale-neutral and preserves six-language architecture.
Operational trust and reproducibility strengthen the differentiated governed product.
Private pilot flags keep public launch, billing and live sources disabled.
Only minimum operator identity is used and credentials remain host-local.
The AXIGNAL route and Compose project have narrow rollback and kill switches.
Local tests and CI definitions directly advance the authorised compatibility PR gate.
